learning_outcomes.text: Students understand the functioning of thermal turbomachinery and describe their areas of application.

They can carry out thermodynamic evaluations of energy conversion machines and the underlying processes, assess them comparatively, and analyze systems. Students can also calculate the essential components from a thermo-fluid dynamic perspective.
Graduates of this module are able to select suitable machines for a specific task. Students recognize current trends in the development of thermal turbomachinery and explain the reasons behind them.
Students develop solutions for the interaction of turbomachinery and plant and identify the decisive requirements of a plant for the design of a machine.
Students perform design and partial load calculations as well as test stand experiments and present on the subject area.

syllabus_topics: Thermodynamics and fluid mechanics of compressible flows
Cycle processes, assemblies, designs, areas of application
Turbomachinery (energy conversion, stage design, velocity triangles)
Dimensionless characteristic numbers for the design of turbomachinery
assessment_rules: Graded assessment: Klausur (written exam) as per the applicable study regulations. Ungraded assessment: Experimental work, consisting of 2 experiments.
